claim.raw_value: in lieu of calling a meeting of the Company Stockholders, the Company shall use reasonable best efforts to obtain the Written Consent

attributes.adoption_timing: Immediately after the execution of this Agreement

claim.raw_value: Promptly following the receipt of the Written Consent, the Company will provide Parent with a copy of such Written Consent.

attributes.why_unmapped: Delivery-of-copy-to-Parent obligation; no assertion_kind covers post-consent notice to Parent

claim.raw_value: the Company shall take actions necessary or advisable to comply, and shall comply in all respects, with the DGCL, including Section 228 and Section 262 thereof, and the Charter and Bylaws of the Company.

attributes.why_unmapped: Statutory/charter compliance covenant tied to the written consent process; no assertion_kind covers general legal-compliance obligations

claim.raw_value: As promptly as practicable following the execution of this Agreement, Parent shall file with the SEC a registration statement on Form S-4

The Company shall use its reasonable best efforts to cause the Information Statement/Prospectus to be mailed to the Company Stockholders as promptly as practicable after the Registration Statement is declared effective.

an information statement of the type contemplated by Rule 14c-2 of the Exchange Act containing the information specified in Schedule 14C under the Exchange Act concerning the Written Consent and the transactions

attributes.why_unmapped: References an already-given Written Consent as the adoption mechanism but does not itself state the mechanism's establishment or timing within this section

claim.raw_value: Parent shall use all reasonable best efforts to have the Registration Statement declared effective under the Securities Act, and the Company shall use all reasonable best efforts to have the Information Statement/Prospectus cleared by the SEC and its staff under the Exchange Act, in each case, as promptly as practicable after such filing.

attributes.why_unmapped: Describes SEC-clearance/effectiveness efforts rather than a filing or mailing deadline with a recognized anchor

claim.raw_value: sufficiently in advance of the mailing of the Information Statement/Prospectus to be included therein

attributes.why_unmapped: Timing condition on furnishing information to Parent, not a mailing obligation itself

claim.raw_value: file with the SEC an appropriate amendment or supplement to such filing describing such information and, to the extent required by applicable law or the SEC or its staff, disseminate any such amendment or supplement to the Company Stockholders

attributes.why_unmapped: Contingent corrective filing/dissemination obligation triggered only by a misstatement, with no recognized anchor (tied to Effective Time, not agreement date/mailing/SEC clearance)

Immediately following the execution and delivery of this Agreement

attributes.adoption_timing: Immediately following the execution and delivery of this Agreement

claim.raw_value: Parent shall vote or cause to be voted any shares of Company Common Stock beneficially owned by it or any of its Subsidiaries or which it or any of its Subsidiaries has the power to cause to be voted, in favor of the adoption of this Agreement at any meeting of stockholders of the Company at which this Agreement shall be submitted for adoption, including all adjournments, recesses or postponements thereof

attributes.meeting_ref: any meeting of stockholders of the Company at which this Agreement shall be submitted for adoption
